about: The checked-in source permission manifest (spec section 6, 'Scrapling specific engineering contract'): permitted domains and purpose, robots and access decisions, rate limits, retained fields and attribution. The page classes and what each may keep are the session 1 rights policy (H-06; docs/reviews/session-1.md, corpus/README.md). A host not listed here is class 'other': it may be fetched when its robots.txt allows, but only the content hash and the claims' minimal excerpts are kept, and its rights status stays 'pending human rights review'. A person supplying a URL never overrides an entry here.
user_agent: NessaL0/1 (local career-planning research; one person's own job search)
robots: robots.txt is read before every page fetch, per host, and obeyed for the user-agent token 'NessaL0' (RFC 9309: an unavailable robots.txt allows; an unreachable one disallows).

retained_fields: claims with minimal excerpts (a JSON pointer each)
sources.attribution: Label each displayed advert "Adzuna", hyperlinked to http://www.adzuna.co.uk (Adzuna API terms).
sources.terms: Adzuna API Terms of Service (https://developer.adzuna.com/docs/terms_of_service, no date on the page): permitted uses include "Personal job search" and "Personal and academic research"; "An API user shall label each displayed advert with the phrase "Adzuna" ... hyperlinked to http://www.adzuna.co.uk"; no retention period is stated, and on termination "an API user shall immediately remove all insertion codes and data acquired from Adzuna". The terms do not clearly allow keeping more than a reference, so the session 1 class 'job-board' keeps hash and excerpts only. Descriptions are snippets: "we currently only provide a snipped of the job description in the response" (https://developer.adzuna.com/docs/search).
